Highlights include a handmade Guilloché dial composed of Anodized Niobium with finely polished Breguet style hands. Housed in a 316L brushed case and polished bezel with sapphire crystals on front and back. Powered by a highly decorated (Level D4) Sellita SW210-4b hand-wound movement, Sellita Top Adjustment (4 ±4 s/d) for accuracy, 10ATM of water resistance, and featuring a handmade ostrich belly leather strap. MATERIAL 316L Stainless Steel FINISH Bright Polished CASE SHAPE Modified Cushion with Round Dial CASE SIZE 40mm WATER RESISTANCE 20 ATM LUG-TO-LUG 48mm LUG WIDTH 22mm THICKNESS 12.9mm (including crystal) MOVEMENT Manual MOVEMENT CALIBRE Sellita SW210-4b hand-winding movement, no-date MOVEMENT GRADE Sellita Top (±4 s/d MOVEMENT FINISH GRADE D4 Luxurious Decoration. D4 represents the most luxurious execution of Sellita movements. It includes the D3 decoration with circular graining and côtes de Genève on most surfaces with the addition of circular graining on the main plate and, as far as it is visible, snailing on the barrel. JEWELS 18 HACKING Yes FREQUENCY 28’800 vibrations per hour (4 Hz) POWER RESERVE ~56 hours CRYSTAL Sapphire, Domed with 6 layers of anti-reflective coating CASEBACK Exhibition Caseback with Sapphire Crystal DIAL Translucent Vitreous Enamel set on a Rose Engine Turned Fine Silver Dial HANDS Finely Polished Breguet Style
